verdict.rationale: 3 distribution signals are alerting (feature, target, prediction), but the frozen model's error was measured over the same windows and did not degrade. Inputs moved and the model tracked them: that is drift worth watching, not proof the champion needs refitting.

reasons.detail: 13/14 feature(s) above PSI 0.2; worst is demand_roll_max_24h at PSI 21.292
actual demand PSI 0.317, mean moved +698 MWh between the reference and current windows
forecast PSI 1.301, mean moved -2,522 MWh (label-free signal: available before the actuals arrive)

windows.strategy: time-ordered train / reference / current; the booster is fitted on the train window only, so both scored windows are out of sample

monitoring_model.reason: the champion was trained on data up to 2026-08-02T00:00:00+00:00, which covers the reference window opening at 2026-07-19T00:00:00+00:00; scoring it there would be in-sample

feature.summary: 13/14 feature(s) above PSI 0.2; worst is demand_roll_max_24h at PSI 21.292
feature.description: distribution shift in the model inputs (leading indicator)
feature.note: deterministic calendar columns are reported but excluded from the verdict — their PSI measures which dates the windows cover, not the data

target.summary: actual demand PSI 0.317, mean moved +698 MWh between the reference and current windows
target.description: distribution shift in the observed demand (a new load regime)

prediction.summary: forecast PSI 1.301, mean moved -2,522 MWh (label-free signal: available before the actuals arrive)
prediction.description: distribution shift in the model output; the only drift signal that needs no ground truth, so it is the earliest one available

performance.description: degradation of the frozen model's rolling error; the only signal that proves harm, and the slowest, because it waits for the actuals

timeline.description: PSI of a trailing 7-day window against the whole reference window, one point per day — the drift-over-time series the dashboard plots

evidently.note: independent second opinion; Evidently picks its own test and thresholds per column and is NOT wired into the retrain trigger
